When the broken footsteps come to the mountain and shrink the brain, I am surprised to see a long person in the empty sky." Inscriptions: "A person from outside the Shanhaiguan", "And the garden of his peers" and "finger painting". There are two appreciation seals.　　This picture is a representative work of Gao's "finger painting" of people. The so-called finger painting, i.e., painting with fingers dipped in ink instead of brushes, uses different parts of the paper, such as fingertips, nails, finger backs, and palm edges, to draw lines of different textures, maintaining the traditional rhythm of brush painting, but also having its own simple, robust and special flavor, thus being able to express objects with ease. The figures and rocks in this picture are modeled and chafed by the author's finger-painting, because they are not constrained by the brush, so the lines are flying and flowing, and the dots are loose and active, which is interesting.
